svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: What the censor actually looks at
Every bar is one TLS record: height is its size, position is when it was sent. All three streams are encrypted.
WireGuard, Shadowsocks, OpenVPN. The payload is encrypted, the shape is not.
A person using a web application
Bursts of mixed record sizes, idle gaps while they read.
Chamele0nX carrying the same VPN traffic
The same bytes as the top row, reshaped to the distribution of the middle row.
A classifier separates the top row from the middle one without decrypting anything. The bottom row is what this project produces.
